title: B1.11 AgeTracer saturation-weighted age over one-metre groundwater plane

baseline.source_equation: AgeTracer task-2 one metre groundwater plane clipped-compartment accumulation lines 1006-1020

scope.inputs: Explicit clipped compartment top/bottom elevations, updated age concentration, saturated water content, water-table elevation, and legacy no-value sentinel
scope.equations: For each source-visited compartment, clip zztop=min(z_top,gwl), zzbot=max(z_bottom,gwl-100), deltaz=zztop-zzbot; sum1 += deltaz*Ageml*thetas; sum0 += deltaz*thetas; initialize result to -9999.9; if sum0>1e-12 set sum1/sum0.

qualification: Compare source-ordered clipped segment integrations against direct B1.11 expressions at O0/O2
Exercise no overlap, partial/full clipping, zero overlap, and sum0 threshold
Reject invalid dimensions/nonfinite or inverted geometry inputs
No task-state, grid-boundary, restart, or production output claim
decision_rule: Preserve legacy sentinel and strict sum0>1e-12 test; do not infer behavior for source grid-index edge cases outside the supplied bounded segment vector.
